freshResearch.method: First-party web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded GETs and inspection of the official Sichuan viewer HTML and current JavaScript/configuration. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement was used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Sichuan Government Services record identifies Xichang Natural Resources Bureau as the implementing body and gives its Xichang service location. The page describes a government service/procedure, not an anonymous parcel feature API.

Official Sichuan Natural Resources report describes the Xichang real-estate registration center's one-stop registration operations and online registration-plus-finance workflow. It establishes local registration custody, not public parcel geometry access.

Official Sichuan Tianditu viewer loaded anonymously. Current HTML and JavaScript/configuration exposed public basemap, imagery, terrain and general resource-layer references, but no parcel/cadastral feature layer, safe identity schema, CRS metadata for parcels, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry route.

requests.assessment: Official service page loaded and contained Xichang Natural Resources Bureau custodian/service details; no parcel geometry endpoint or safe parcel response was exposed.
Viewer HTML loaded anonymously; linked scripts and map routes were inspected. No parcel feature route was identified.
Current configuration was inspected. It references public map/resource layers but no cadastral parcel schema or ID-plus-geometry service.
Current map constants were inspected for service routes; no parcel endpoint was exposed.

An incorrectly formed alternate official Natural Resources URL was attempted and returned 404; the valid first-party result URL above was used for evidence. This access failure is not evidence of cadastral absence.
